unity.version.title: Unity version
unity.version.summary: Version: {version} ({sources} source(s) of kinds: {kinds}; {conflicts} disagreement(s), see evidence). Priority: globalgamemanagers > binary strings > other SerializedFiles > AssetBundle headers > unity default resources (often a stale editor version).

unity.backend.title: Scripting backend
unity.backend.summary: Result: {backend} (il2cpp: global-metadata.dat present and no loose managed assemblies; mono: Data/Managed assemblies and no metadata; both or neither: unknown).

unity.metadata.encrypted.title: global-metadata.dat encryption / tampering check
unity.metadata.encrypted.summary: Metadata version {version}, sampled entropy {entropy}; reasons: {reasons}; header consistent: {header_ok}; file: {path}. This is a heuristic, not proof; a version beyond Il2CppDumper's range is not evidence of encryption.
unity.metadata.encrypted.remediation: Verify manually with references/unity-il2cpp-metadata.md; this tool never decrypts. --force-dump forces a dump attempt.

unity.binary.fairplay.title: FairPlay status of the il2cpp binary
unity.binary.fairplay.summary: Binary: {path}. FairPlay-encrypted code cannot be read by any dumper and this tool never decrypts it.
unity.binary.fairplay.remediation: Provide an IPA that its owner has already decrypted and analyse again.

unity.il2cpp.precheck.title: il2cpp dump pre-check
unity.il2cpp.precheck.summary: Error code: {error_code}; reasons: {reasons}; backends supporting this metadata version: {backends}.

unity.il2cpp.dump.title: il2cpp dump result
unity.il2cpp.dump.summary: State: {state}; backend: {backend} {backend_version}; classes {classes} / methods {methods}; output: {out_dir}; error code: {error_code}; {message}
unity.il2cpp.dump.remediation: See the remediation for the error code and references/il2cpp-troubleshooting.md.

unity.il2cpp.names_obfuscated.title: Identifier obfuscation
unity.il2cpp.names_obfuscated.summary: Obfuscation level: {level} (score {score}, source: {source}; a dump-based result is more reliable than the metadata string-table estimate).

unity.assetbundle.encryption.title: AssetBundle encryption check
unity.assetbundle.encryption.summary: {total} candidate file(s) ({population} counted); classes: {counts}; deep-checked sample: {sampled}. Compression is not encryption; the verdict is a heuristic.
unity.assetbundle.encryption.remediation: See references/unity-assetbundle.md for the meaning of each class and how to verify manually.

unity.mono.dll_encrypted.title: Managed assembly (Mono) integrity
unity.mono.dll_encrypted.summary: {total} managed assembly(ies), {invalid} invalid (not PE/CLI); possible obfuscator markers: {hints} (low confidence).

unity.class.xor_simple: Header XORed with a short key
